title: Northgate Benefit Eligibility Across Northgate Marketplace Seller Programs
content:
Which of Northgate's own customer benefits reach a marketplace item depends only on the seller program of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee under which the item is sold. The six seller programs of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee are Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled, Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller, Northgate Marketplace Fulfilled by Northgate, Northgate Marketplace Freight Seller, Northgate Marketplace Certified Renewed and Northgate Marketplace International Seller; the columns below carry their names without the Northgate Marketplace prefix.

| Term | Seller-Fulfilled | Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Northgate | Freight Seller | Certified Renewed | International Seller |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Membership delivery benefits can apply | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| Northgate Card cardholder discount applies | No | No | Yes | No | No | No |
| Northgate Cash is earned on the items | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Northgate price adjustment or price match applies | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| A Northgate Protect plan can cover the item | No | No | No | No | No | No |

**Points of reading.** A Yes in the first two rows appears only under Fulfilled by Northgate. The last three rows read No on every program.
